title: A board that stays with you
caption: A clearly labelled fictional repair-day board. Review a real causal conflict, or start your own workspace.

title: Context for the next person
caption: Each task records a title, owner, status and handoff notes. This is the actual editable task form.

title: Create useful handoff notes
caption: Add a task with an owner and practical notes. The form validates before saving on this device.

title: Start your own workspace
caption: The new Book drive handoff board contains a locally saved task, created through the real app.

title: Prepare an encrypted snapshot
caption: The full board history is encrypted locally. Export a file or prepare numbered QR packets.

title: A repeating optical handoff
caption: Genuine encrypted QR packets repeat on screen. Share the passphrase separately; file exchange remains available.

title: Missing packets stay visible
caption: The receiver decoded real QR image pixels. Reordered packets and a duplicate leave an incomplete package unimported.

title: Fail safely, keep the board
caption: An incorrect passphrase is rejected. Nothing imports, and the current workspace is preserved.

title: Review before merging
caption: A decrypted task preview and new-update count appear before the user explicitly accepts the handoff.

title: Two updates. One human decision.
caption: Independent status edits from isolated browser contexts survive the merge and appear together for review.

title: A decision with its context
caption: Choosing a status records a new update that observes both earlier versions. Previous history is retained.

title: Follow the update history
caption: Inspect authors, field changes and causal parent counts. Labels and timestamps are informational, not verified identity.

title: The connection can stop
caption: The installed app reopens with browser networking disabled. Initial installation still requires a complete online load.

title: Clear product boundaries
caption: The in-app guide explains handoffs, plaintext local storage, prototype limits and camera-testing boundaries.

title: A smaller screen, the same work
caption: A real 390px responsive viewport, presented without stretching. Physical device camera performance remains untested.
